title: Discount Tiers & Percentage Clamping
brief: As a shopper, I want to apply a coupon to my order, so that I pay the discounted price.

steps.summary: Define the coupon and order-summary types
Add the pricing tests and document coupons

probes.question: A shopper applies a 100% coupon to a mug that costs 1200 cents. What discount does discountFor give?
options: It throws: the coupon cannot exceed 100

expected.Flawed: It throws: the coupon cannot exceed 100

probes.question: An order has 2 mugs at 1200 cents and a fixed coupon of 3000 cents. What is the total?

items.question: Can a shopper use a coupon that makes an item free (100% off)?
options: Yes: the discount is the full price
Yes, but the total goes negative

items.question: What does an order summary contain besides the items?
options: Subtotal, discount, total and the coupon
The total and a list of taxes

items.question: An order has 3 pens at 300 cents each and a 10% coupon. What is the total?
Suppose a fixed coupon were no longer capped at the order's subtotal, so a large coupon made the total negative. Would the agent's unit tests notice?
options: Yes: at least one unit test fails
No: all unit tests still pass
The tests stop with an error before any test runs
Only the type checker (tsc) would report it
